heading: INT. CATERING VAN, PARKED BEHIND SYMPHONY HALL - NIGHT

units.text: INT. CATERING VAN, PARKED BEHIND SYMPHONY HALL - NIGHT
Metal shelving.
Trays of canapés.
A thermos.
Four people in black waiter uniforms crowd the back of the van, their tuxedo jackets half-unbuttoned.
JOSEFINA "FINA" QUISPE-LARSEN (40s, crew boss) unrolls a blueprint on a cooler lid.
TREVOR ASANTE (30s, gloves, a canvas bag) checks a watch.
OLIVIA BRANDT (20s, earpiece, nervous) tucks a cable under her cuff.
And WALLACE "WALLY" DRUMMOND (60s, an actual caterer's apron over the tux) props a tray against the door.
Vault's under the cello section. Trevor goes in through the green room. Olivia takes the stairs. Wally, you walk the floor with the canapés.
units.name: FINA

units.text: I'm not a thief, I'm a caterer.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: Today you're both.
units.name: FINA

units.text: The guard rotates at ten twenty.
units.name: TREVOR

units.text: Ten twenty-two. I checked.
units.name: OLIVIA

units.text: It's ten twenty.
units.name: TREVOR

units.text: I checked the rotation, not the time.
units.name: OLIVIA

units.text: Children. Children.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: We have six minutes. Trevor, the bag.
units.name: FINA

units.text: Trevor hands her the canvas bag.
She unzips it.
Out come four tuxedo vests, each with a small lump sewn in.
She tosses them around.
They catch them, fumble, button up.
Is this a camera?
units.name: OLIVIA

units.text: It's a microphone. The camera is in Wally's tray.
units.name: TREVOR

units.text: There's a camera in my tray?
units.name: WALLY

units.text: There's a camera in the pâté.
units.name: TREVOR

units.text: I'll never serve pâté again.
units.name: WALLY

units.text: Wally, go. Smile. Walk slowly. The vault door opens at ten twenty-six.
units.name: FINA

units.text: Wally lifts the tray.
Pushes the van door open.
Trevor slips out behind him; Olivia follows; Fina climbs down last, closing the door softly as she goes.
Outside, footsteps crunch gravel.
A flashlight beam swings across the van's windshield.
The four freeze.
Wally lowers the tray.
Trevor holds his breath.
Olivia grips her cuff.
Fina's hand slides to the door latch.
Do I smile?
units.name: WALLY

units.text: Smile.
units.name: FINA

units.text: He smiles.
The beam slides across his face, hesitates, moves on.
Gravel crunches away.
Wally exhales so hard his tray shakes.
